translation:
In the conditions of injury with wheezing and coughing, if it is due to excessive loss of blood, with a black face, distension of the chest, and pain of the chest and diaphragm with wheezing, this is qi deficiency with blood riding up into the lung (肺); urgently use Two-Ingredient Ginseng and Sappan Decoction (二味參蘇飲); if delayed, it will be difficult to save. If there is coughing of blood and nosebleed with wheezing, this is qi rebelling with blood accumulating in the lung; one should only invigorate the blood and move the qi, and must not use the purging method; one should treat it with Ten-Ingredient Ginseng and Perilla Decoction (十味參蘇飲). <ins>Two-Ingredient Ginseng and Sappan Decoction (二味參蘇飲)</ins>
Ginseng (人參, one liang), sappan wood (蘇木, two liang)
Decoct in water and take.
